subtitle.simpleText:
A technical and artistic showcase, focused on highly stylized rendering and animation.

The goals of the project are to push Blender in the production of 2D/3D animation, using the ongoing developments on Geometry Nodes, Grease Pencil and Cycles.

title.simpleText: Developing the 2D look of Wing It! #animation #blender #cartoon #b3d #2d

subtitle.simpleText:
Get an insight into Blender Studio's next open movie project: WING IT! (codename Pet Projects) - a 2D-stylised animated short! This is the first episode of a video series that shares the process, experiments and insights of the artists behind the project. 

To check out more exclusive content, get the production files, assets, regular production logs and lessons by joining the Blender Studio at https://studio.blender.org/wing-it

Blender Studio is the creative part of the Blender HQ. A dedicated team of artists and developers challenge themselves with creative-technical targets to help Blender users and to drive Blender development forward. This happens in an open source production environment and by sharing everything they make in an open and free license.
